verdict.rationale: Apple's own M4 Pro newsroom spec publishes the three numbers needed to size memory-bound work: unified memory (CPU/GPU shared pool) as the memory type, a 64GB capacity ceiling, and 273GB/s bandwidth. Sizing is possible directly from vendor figures, but the only source is a single press-release line. missing for 10: explicit DRAM generation/type (e.g. LPDDR variant), bus width or transfer-rate detail, per-configuration memory options in a tech-spec doc, independent corroboration of the bandwidth figure.

support.subject: As a developer, I can size memory-bound workloads from the vendor's own numbers — published memory type, capacity ceiling, and bandwidth (or spec detail complete enough to derive it)

citations.quote: M4 Pro supports up to 64GB of fast unified memory and 273GB/s of memory bandwidth
